name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina Herrera's career began unexpectedly in the bustling ports of Buenos Aires, managing the intricate logistics of international cargo. Her sharp organizational skills and knack for problem-solving caught the eye of a local racing team, struggling to navigate the complexities of transporting equipment across South America. Intrigued by the speed and precision of motorsport, Valentina made the leap. 

She thrives on the pressure of race weekends, meticulously planning every detail from fuel delivery to spare parts inventory. Her approach is data-driven, constantly analyzing logistical bottlenecks to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime. Valentina's reputation for unwavering reliability and her ability to anticipate potential crises has made her an indispensable asset to any team she joins. Her 'big picture' thinking allows her to foresee potential issues and proactively implement solutions, ensuring the smooth operation of race events.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle waves and a side part.
physical.description: Valentina is a woman of medium height, with a composed demeanor and a warm, intelligent gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with logistical charts and diagrams.
Insists on a daily 'systems check' meeting, no matter how brief, to ensure everyone is on the same page.
Secretly collects miniature racing car models, displaying them discreetly in her office.
